# @ndigo/telemetry-web

Browser telemetry for Ndigo — browser telemetry configuration and web instrumentations

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `configureBrowserTelemetry` — Configures the global OpenTelemetry providers for a browser process.
- `BrowserTelemetryConfig` *(type)* — Browser telemetry configuration: the service name reported on every signal, an optional OTLP/HTTP `traceUrl`, and `useConsoleExporters` to silence the console…
- `BrowserTelemetryHandle` *(type)* — Handle returned by configureBrowserTelemetry — explicit lifecycle for hosts that own the page (SPAs, tests).
- `AuthClientInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `AuthClientInstrumentation`.
- `RouterInstrumentation` — An OpenTelemetry instrumentation for the `@ndigo/router` package, specifically `HashRouter`.
- `ContextInstrumentation`
- `DispatcherInstrumentation`
- `WebSocketClientInstrumentation` — Instrumentation for WebSocketClient: outbound message and byte counters + exactly one counted `close()` per session (a close that follows a terminal drop count…
- `countSocketClientStatus` — Status-transition metric wiring for a `WebSocketClient` — use as the client's `onStatusChange` option (constructor-injected seam; the client is app-constructed…
- `countSocketClientBytes` — Exact outbound-byte wiring for a `WebSocketClient` — use as the client's `onSend` option (constructor-injected; the client reports the actual bytes written to…
